```{mermaid}
%%{init: {'themeVariables': {'titleColor': '#000000', 'edgeLabelBackground': '#ffffff00'}}}%%
flowchart TD
    %% ── Data Preparation ────────────────────────────────────────────
    A["🗄️ Full Sample"]
    A --> B["📋 Training Set"]
    A --> C["🧪 Testing Set"]

    %% ── Phase 1 node declarations ───────────────────────────────────
    subgraph Phase1 ["Nuisance Model Selection"]
        direction TB
        subgraph P1in ["Inputs"]
            direction LR
            P1T["📋 Training Set"]
            CAND1["🤖 Candidate ML Models"]
        end
        P1nt("🔁 Cross-Validation<br>via NuisanceTuner")
        H["🔵 Selected<br>Nuisance Models"]
    end

    %% ── Phase 2 node declarations ───────────────────────────────────
    subgraph Phase2 ["CATE Model Selection"]
        direction TB
        subgraph P2in ["Inputs"]
            direction LR
            P2T["📋 Training Set"]
            P2N["🔵 Nuisance Models"]
            P2C["🤖 Candidate CATE Models"]
            P2S["📐 CATE Scorer"]
        end
        CV2("🔁 Cross-Validation")
        XFIT1("⚡ Within-CATE model<br>Nuisance Cross-Fitting<br>CV Training Fold")
        XFIT2("⚡ Within-CATE Scorer<br>Nuisance Cross-Fitting<br>CV Validation Fold")
        M["🟠 Selected<br>CATE Model"]
    end

    %% ── Phase 3 node declarations ────────────────────────────────────
    subgraph Phase3 ["Final Evaluation"]
        direction TB
        subgraph P3in ["Inputs"]
            direction LR
            P3T["📋 Training Set"]
            P3CM["🟠 Selected<br>CATE Model"]
            P3TEST["🧪 Testing Set"]
        end
        TR1("🏋️ Train CATE model<br>on Training Set")
        SCORE("📏 Score<br>on Testing Set")
        REPORT["📊 Test Scoring<br>Report"]
    end


    %% ── Heuristic Gate ────────────────────────────────────────────────
    HEURISTIC["💡 Heuristic Step"]

    %% ── Phase 4 node declarations ────────────────────────────────────
    subgraph Phase4 ["Final Training"]
        direction TB
        subgraph P4in ["Inputs"]
            direction LR
            P4T["📋 Training Set"]
            P4CM["🟠 Selected<br>CATE Model"]
            P4TEST["🧪 Testing Set"]
        end
        TR2("🏋️ Retrain CATE model<br>on Full Data")
        FINAL["🏆 Final Production<br>CATE Model"]
    end

    %% ── All edges ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    P1T --> P1nt
    CAND1 --> P1nt
    P1nt --> H

    H -.-> P2N
    P2T --> CV2
    P2N --> CV2
    P2C --> CV2
    P2S --> CV2
    CV2 --> XFIT1
    CV2 --> XFIT2
    XFIT1 --> M
    XFIT2 --> M

    M -.-> P3CM
    P3T --> TR1
    P3CM --> TR1
    P3TEST --> SCORE
    TR1 --> SCORE

    REPORT -.->|"✅ validated"| HEURISTIC
    HEURISTIC -.->|"🚀 retrain"| TR2

    M -.-> P4CM
    P4T --> TR2
    P4CM --> TR2
    P4TEST --> TR2
    TR2 --> FINAL
    SCORE --> REPORT

    %% ── Subgraph styling ─────────────────────────────────────────────
    style Phase1  fill:#eff6ff,stroke:#1971c2,stroke-width:2px,stroke-dasharray:6
    style Phase2  fill:#fff8ed,stroke:#e67700,stroke-width:2px,stroke-dasharray:6
    style Phase3  fill:#f5f0ff,stroke:#7048e8,stroke-width:2px,stroke-dasharray:6
    style Phase4  fill:#e6fcf5,stroke:#0ca678,stroke-width:2px,stroke-dasharray:6
    style P1in    fill:#dbe4ff,stroke:#1971c2,stroke-width:1px,stroke-dasharray:3
    style P2in    fill:#ffe8cc,stroke:#e67700,stroke-width:1px,stroke-dasharray:3
    style P3in    fill:#e5dbff,stroke:#7048e8,stroke-width:1px,stroke-dasharray:3
    style P4in    fill:#c3fae8,stroke:#0ca678,stroke-width:1px,stroke-dasharray:3

    %% ── Node styling ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
    %% Top-level data nodes — larger font + thicker border
    classDef dataNodeLg  fill:#ffffff,stroke:#343a40,stroke-width:3px,color:#212529,font-size:17px,font-weight:bold
    classDef trainNodeLg fill:#ebfbee,stroke:#2f9e44,stroke-width:3px,color:#1a5c2a,font-size:17px,font-weight:bold
    classDef testNodeLg  fill:#fff0f6,stroke:#c2255c,stroke-width:3px,color:#7a0030,font-size:17px,font-weight:bold

    %% In-subgraph data / artifact nodes — smaller
    classDef trainNode   fill:#ebfbee,stroke:#2f9e44,stroke-width:2px,color:#1a5c2a,font-size:13px,font-weight:bold
    classDef testNode    fill:#fff0f6,stroke:#c2255c,stroke-width:2px,color:#7a0030,font-size:13px,font-weight:bold
    classDef inputNode   fill:#f8f9fa,stroke:#868e96,stroke-width:1px,color:#343a40,font-size:13px
    classDef nuisanceOut fill:#d0ebff,stroke:#1971c2,stroke-width:2px,color:#1864ab,font-size:13px,font-weight:bold
    classDef cateOut     fill:#ffec99,stroke:#e67700,stroke-width:2px,color:#7c4a00,font-size:13px,font-weight:bold
    classDef finalOut    fill:#ffc9c9,stroke:#c2255c,stroke-width:2px,color:#7a0030,font-size:13px,font-weight:bold
    classDef evalOut     fill:#c3fae8,stroke:#0ca678,stroke-width:2px,color:#087f5b,font-size:13px,font-weight:bold

    %% Heuristic note node — sticky-note feel
    classDef noteNode fill:#fffde7,stroke:#f9a825,stroke-width:2px,stroke-dasharray:5,color:#5f4000,font-size:12px

    %% Action / process nodes (rounded rect shape via diagram syntax)
    classDef actionNode  fill:#f8f9fa,stroke:#868e96,stroke-width:1px,color:#343a40,font-size:13px

    %% ── Class assignments ────────────────────────────────────────────
    class A dataNodeLg
    class B trainNodeLg
    class C testNodeLg

    class P1T,P2T,P3T,P4T trainNode
    class P4TEST,P3TEST testNode
    class CAND1,P2C,P2S inputNode
    class H,P2N nuisanceOut
    class M,P3CM,P4CM cateOut
    class FINAL finalOut
    class REPORT evalOut
    class HEURISTIC noteNode

    class P1nt,CV2,XFIT1,XFIT2,TR1,SCORE,TR2 actionNode
```
